verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents a few multi-item operations. Via its MCP integration, one prompt can check read status across many emails, draft all the nudges and schedule each send. A community user also reports trashing or marking done all messages from the same sender, and Split Inbox lets you work through same-type emails together. However, no general-purpose bulk select-and-act capability is documented. Missing for 10: documented general multi-select bulk actions (archive, label or move many arbitrary items at once), first-party docs on bulk scope and limits, and hands-on corroboration of AI-driven bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
you can focus on a specific topic — and get through emails of the same type, at the same time.
